**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment by Meridian: "Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 7.1** and **§ 8.3** are pricing protections running in our favour (fixed Fees during the initial term, no undisclosed charges, renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%) — no obligation on us to match or extend third-party terms to Copperleaf.
- Targeted searches for MFN / "no less favourable" / best-pricing / third-party-matching language returned no hits elsewhere in the document.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no MFN obligation burdening the Customer), so nothing to change.
